{{Quote|Yes, R2. The crops look like they've completely dried up.|C-3PO comments on the effect of the moisture eater on Biituian trees|<ref name="Heep" />}}
The tall '''trees''' growing on<ref name="Heep" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Biitu system/Legends|Biitu system]]</ref> [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Biitu]] had light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] bark and green [[Plant/Legends|leaves]]. They produced orange [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Diet/Legends|consumable]] by both the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Biituian]]s and [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]].<ref name="Heep" />

On Biitu, the native Biituians cultivated the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] in vast orchards, harvesting their fruit in large baskets. However, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] claimed Biitu for its valuable [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], several of these trees were stripped of foliage and uprooted by the fierce winds produced by a low fly-over of an Imperial [[Starship/Legends|craft]]. These orchards later became barren as an Imperial "[[moisture eater]]" drained all [[Water/Legends|moisture]] from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and caused a drought. However, resistance from the Biituian [[Fidge Tadrazan|Fidge]] and his pet [[Chubb]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] led to the destruction of the moisture eater and the defeat of Imperial forces. The return of moisture allowed the fruit trees to grow again, and the Biituians utilized captured Imperials to restore the crops.<ref name="Heep" />

==Behind the scenes==
The trees appeared in ''[[The Great Heep]]'', a [[1986]] [[Wikipedia:Television film|television movie]] serving as a tie-in to the the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] animated television series.<ref name="Heep" />
